name: arxiv
description: ArXiv browsing for agents: search the arXiv API, cache papers locally (HTML rendering → text pages for paginated reading), track phrases with a rotating new-paper poll. No credentials required.
author: Kestrel

phrases.description: JSON array of search queries for the poll rotation, e.g. ["electron correlation lattice", "agent memory"]

seen.description: JSON array of recently seen arxiv ids (poll dedupe, capped at 1000)

library.description: JSON object: cached-paper index keyed by arxiv id

commands.name: search
commands.description: Search arXiv. Plain terms are AND-joined (all:field); quoted phrases group; field queries (cat:, ti:, abs:, au:) and boolean operators (AND/OR/ANDNOT, parens) pass through verbatim. Result echoes executed_query — the query arXiv actually ran — so server-side rewrites are visible. sort: submittedDate | relevance | lastUpdatedDate.

commands.name: paper abstract
commands.description: Full metadata + abstract for any arXiv paper by id. No caching — the cheap existence + metadata check.

commands.name: paper cache
commands.description: Cache a paper for reading: fetch metadata, pull the arXiv HTML rendering, strip to text, split into ~8KB pages in the package filespace. Falls back to abstract-only when no rendering exists. Re-caching replaces the old copy. include_pdf=true also archives the PDF binary.

commands.name: paper read
commands.description: Read one page of a cached paper (paginated reading; use next_page to walk). ~8KB of clean text per page, math inline as $LaTeX$.

commands.name: cache list
commands.description: List the local reading library: everything cached with mode, page count, and size.

commands.name: cache remove
commands.description: Remove a paper from the library: pages, metadata, and optional PDF.

commands.name: poll
commands.description: New-paper check. With 'phrase': checks that phrase once (rotation untouched). Without: queries one configured phrase per invocation (rotating), returns papers not seen before. Politeness: schedule no tighter than one call per few minutes. New hits are recorded but never auto-cached; triage is the agent's call. Configure the rotation with the 'phrases add' command. A phrase failing 3 consecutive polls is skipped — the rotation advances past it.

commands.name: phrases add
commands.description: Append a search phrase to the poll rotation (agent self-configuration — no admin state access needed).

commands.name: phrases remove
commands.description: Remove a phrase from the rotation (exact match).

commands.name: phrases list
commands.description: Show the poll rotation, cursor position, and next phrase.
